meeting_summary.going: Straight: yielding; round: good to yielding

races.name: Army Equitation Centenary Irish European Breeders Fund Maiden
races.verdict:
HMAS PERTH left his debut form behind when runner-up at Doncaster earlier this month, pulling clear of the rest, and he looks to hold leading claims of getting off the mark this time around. Maximilien Luce boasts a fine pedigree and helps to give Aidan O'Brien a strong hand in the race, with Yellow Sky completing the shortlist.

  1. HMAS PERTH (USA)
  2. MAXIMILIEN LUCE (IRE)
  3. YELLOW SKY (IRE)

races.name: Izuzu Ireland Irish European Breeders Fund Maiden
races.verdict:
Aidan O'Brien looks to have a strong hand in this but not for the first time this season he may have to play second fiddle to son Joseph, CLUSTER selected to go a couple of places better than on debut (yard's juvenile runners tend to come on appreciably from their debut). Kingdom of Camelot is seemingly the choice of Ryan Moore, so he heads up the dangers, with Greatest Knight and Capability Brown also fancied to feature.

  1. CLUSTER
  2. KINGDOM OF CAMELOT (FR)
  3. GREATEST KNIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Qatar Racing And Equestrian Club Renaissance Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
POWER BLUE has fallen short at Group 1 level this year but still looked a smart sort when scoring at this track in a Group 2 in July and this looks a good opportunity to add another success down in trip and grade. Big Gossey is so hard to rule out around here given his incredible course record and he'll run well, while Royal Bay Cen needs considering given how impressive she was fresh earlier in the season.

  1. POWER BLUE (IRE)
  2. BIG GOSSEY (IRE)
  3. ROYAL BAY CEN (IRE)

races.name: Celebrating County Kildare And Lexington Twinning Maiden
races.verdict:
Standard-setter VALENTINO ECLIPSE should appreciate this drop to sprinting and comfortably gets the vote. Otsana has had her debut form franked and can go close again, with Lilli's Angel another to consider for each-way purposes.

  1. VALENTINO ECLIPSE (IRE)
  2. OTSANA (IRE)
  3. LILLI'S ANGEL (IRE)

races.name: Darley Fillies Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
CURRACLOE looked a very useful prospect when making a winning debut at Gowran and, open to plenty of progress, is taken to make an immediate impact at stakes level. Damsel In Distress was placed at this level last time despite looking stretched by 1m and rates the main danger back at 7f, while Alpine Wedding is respected after improving last time but would be better suited by stepping up to 1m.

  1. CURRACLOE (USA)
  2. DAMSEL IN DISTRESS (IRE)
  3. ALPINE WEDDING (IRE)

races.name: Friends Of The Curragh Irish Cesarewitch (0-110) (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict:
An ultra-competitive renewal of this valuable handicap and it may well go the way of Willie Mullins' THE REVEREND. Aidan O'Brien has enjoyed recent success in this race with 3-y-os and his Port Of Spain has to enter calculations. Blake looks a fascinating contender back on the Flat, while Tim Toe, Truth Be Told, Kingstonian and Sky Captain also appeal.

  1. THE REVEREND
  2. PORT OF SPAIN (IRE)
  3. BLAKE

races.name: Kwiff More Bang For Your Bet Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
MOON SAND has shaped as if handicapping will be his bag and it would be no surprise should he step up markedly now switched to nurseries. Romance has been running well of late and can continue in form, with Gabby Hayes and Closefield Beau heading the list of dangers of the rest.

  1. MOON SAND (FR)
  2. ROMANCE (GER)
  3. GABBY HAYES (IRE)

races.name: Kwiff Supercharged Betting (Q.R.) Handicap
races.verdict:
CHIPSRDOWN has been a different proposition since fitted with a visor and with this step up in trip expected to suit, she can defy the handicapper again. Bhean Saibhre has a lowly mark to exploit and is a huge threat if lining up here, with It's Good To Talk a potential improver.

  1. CHIPSRDOWN (IRE)
  2. BHEAN SAIBHRE (IRE)
  3. IT'S GOOD TO TALK (IRE)

races.name: Betfred 'Turbo Boost' Nursery
races.verdict:
GIVE HAND showed much improved form on his second start when third over C&D, the race won by a promising newcomer, and he could be up to making a successful nursery debut with his yard going well. Regal Tiger has been going the right way in his 3 outings so far and is next on the list, ahead of The Ginger Kid.

  1. GIVE HAND (IRE)
  2. REGAL TIGER
  3. THE GINGER KID (IRE)

races.name: Betfred Derby 'Wild Card' EBF Conditions Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Tough to rule out any of the quintet but preference is for ROSE MOON, who looked potentially useful when scoring with something in hand at Salisbury earlier in the month and Ralph Beckett's colt is open to any amount of improvement. Quite Cheeky also made a winning start here recently, so he's put forward as the main threat quickly upped in trip, with Al Wathba rounding off the shortlist.

  1. ROSE MOON (GER)
  2. QUITE CHEEKY (IRE)
  3. AL WATHBA (FR)

races.name: Hunt Family Fund Novice Stakes (Sponsored By Betfred) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BLUE NOON has proved consistent in defeat in handicaps in recent months, not beaten at all far when fifth over this trip at Goodwood 4 weeks ago. She looks to hold sound claims back in novice company with a tongue strap now added. Maestro Del Mar also enters calculations despite conceding weight all round. Seacole and newcomer Rowlf also require a second look.

  1. BLUE NOON (IRE)
  2. MAESTRO DEL MAR (FR)
  3. SEACOLE (IRE)

races.name: Betfred 'Nifty 50' Jump Jockeys Derby Handicap (Professional Jump Jockeys) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
FOX AVATAR hasn’t yet been able to add to last year’s pair of wins, but is now down to a good mark and, with the step back up in trip expected to suit, he looks worth siding with in an open affair. Nibras Gold arrives at the top of his game and looks likely to prove the chief threat if taking to the track, while 3-time C&D winner Gordon Grey and the lightly-raced Seeking Charles are also ones to consider.

  1. FOX AVATAR (IRE)
  2. NIBRAS GOLD (IRE)
  3. GORDON GREY (IRE)

races.name: Betfred 'Bet Builder' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
It's hard not to be taken by the potential shown by MATINS and the 3-y-o can maintain the unbeaten start to his career at the expense of the in-form Echalar.

  1. MATINS
  2. ECHALAR (IRE)
  3. CARNIVAL DAY (IRE)

races.name: Betfred 'The Classic Bookmaker' Handicap
races.verdict:
CROWN OFFICE is well treated on his best form and looks likely to make a bold bid from an inside draw. He's preferred to fast-improving Thanos and C&D winner Swiped.

  1. CROWN OFFICE
  2. THANOS
  3. SWIPED

races.name: Betfred 'Follow Us On X' Handicap
races.verdict:
MUSICAL ANGEL won this race from a similar mark last year and a recent second over C&D served warning that she's ready to strike again. Velvet Rhythm shaped really well last time and is very much respected but her blowout on sole start at this track is a concern, while Silver Trumpet could go well if starting better than last time.

  1. MUSICAL ANGEL
  2. VELVET RHYTHM
  3. SILVER TRUMPET

races.name: Alex And Salvo Welcome You To The Bridge Handicap
races.verdict:
An ordinary race at best with only a handful making any serious appeal, MACARONE getting the nod to complete the hat-trick having been value for extra for his recent narrow Bath success. Sub Thirteen looks the obvious threat on paper, while Blue Point Express turned in her best effort of the season at Chepstow last time so she should be on the premises with a repeat.

  1. MACARONE
  2. SUB THIRTEEN
  3. BLUE POINT EXPRESS (IRE)

races.name: Bridge, The Home Of The Carvery Nursery
races.verdict:
RHODES RUNNER readily got off the mark in a heavy-ground novice at Chester last time and is fancied to follow up. Knock Three Times could be the main danger if headgear has the desired effect. Perigord Noir, Wolf's Gallop and Naval Cop are also worthy of consideration in a tight nursery.

  1. RHODES RUNNER (IRE)
  2. KNOCK THREE TIMES (IRE)
  3. PERIGORD NOIR (IRE)

races.name: Bridge, Family Run And Proud Handicap
races.verdict:
BAMA LAMA has fallen a long way in the weights and looks potentially interesting with Saffie Osborne taking over. She's narrowly preferred to Some Nightmare, who's been knocking on the door, while Call Time is still potentially well treated under a penalty for last week's win here. In-form Outer Edge looks set to be in the shake-up, too, in a trappy sprint.

  1. BAMA LAMA
  2. SOME NIGHTMARE (IRE)
  3. CALL TIME (IRE)

races.name: Happy Birthday Alex, From The Bridge Handicap
races.verdict:
QUEENIE ST CLAIR is potentially very well treated from a mark of 60 back in this sphere given her exploits over hurdles for Nick Schofield last winter and she could well be worthy of siding with having gone well fresh previously. Carthusian proved yet another good advert for the Jennie Candlish team when making a successful yard debut at Chester 8 days ago and rates next best. No Ordinary Joe is one to monitor on handicap debut in this sphere from what could prove a lenient opening mark, too.

  1. QUEENIE ST CLAIR (IRE)
  2. CARTHUSIAN (IRE)
  3. NO ORDINARY JOE (IRE)

races.name: Celebrate In Style At The Bridge Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SILENT FORCE made a promising start when third in a Newbury novice, beaten only by a pair with the benefit of previous experience, and he can build on that effort to open his account. Ghost Raider is feared most.

  1. SILENT FORCE (IRE)
  2. GHOST RAIDER (IRE)
  3. TIME GLORY (IRE)

races.name: Bridge, For All Family Occasions Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
ROSEMARY’S ROSE disappointed last time and has proved expensive to follow this season, but she has already run well twice at this course this year and is worth another chance back in 0-60 company. Prince Ali arrives in good form and rates the main threat despite a 6 lb rise, while Homeland can also be involved if putting his best foot forward.

  1. ROSEMARY'S ROSE (IRE)
  2. PRINCE ALI
  3. HOMELAND

races.name: Bridge, For All Family Occasions Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
ARVANA BELLE has been runner-up twice at this course in the last month and looked unlucky not to win just 6 days ago, going with zest but unable to fully open up until angled into the clear. She can go one better. Kaleidoscope Eyes has won twice here and could be a threat if suited by the step back up to 1m, whilst Desiderata is looking more reliable of late.

  1. ARVANA BELLE (IRE)
  2. KALEIDOSCOPE EYES (IRE)
  3. DESIDERATA (IRE)

races.name: Bridge Llangennech Open Daily Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
By no means a deep handicap so a repeat of the level WELLWHATSHAPPENIN achieved when runner-up in a 1m handicap here a week ago may well suffice. Georg Zhukov was tight in the betting when behind the selection in that aforementioned race and he can be a factor, while The Ormer Gatherer may well show more this time.

  1. WELLWHATSHAPPENIN (IRE)
  2. GEORG ZHUKOV (IRE)
  3. THE ORMER GATHERER

races.name: 4Racing Welcomes You Maiden Plate (F & M)
races.verdict:
THE BACHELORETTE stands out on form and looks to have been found a very good opening. Artifact might be the answer to second spot, while Elegant Edge could be best of the others.

  1. THE BACHELORETTE (SAF)
  2. ARTIFACT (SAF)
  3. ELEGANT EDGE (SAF)

races.name: Betway Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
ASTROPHILE looks the way to go. Two Tigers gets the nod among the rest, while Autograph could also figure.

  1. ASTROPHILE (SAF)
  2. TWO TIGERS (SAF)
  3. AUTOGRAPH (SAF)

races.name: For Hospitality Bookings Call 011 681 1796 Maiden Plate (F & M)
races.verdict:
PURPLE RAIN could be the way to go. Up And Up is a threat, while Royal Rant shouldn't be discarded.

  1. PURPLE RAIN (SAF)
  2. UP AND UP (SAF)
  3. ROYAL RANT (SAF)

races.name: Play Soccer 6, 10 And 13 Fm 91 Divided Handicap (F & M)
races.verdict:
SURPRISE PARTY looks the way to go. Frangipani is a player, while Merryweather is one to bear in mind too.

  1. SURPRISE PARTY (SAF)
  2. FRANGIPANI (SAF)
  3. MERRYWEATHER (SAF)

races.name: Tab Telebet 011 074 0300 Fm 72 Divided Handicap (F & M)
races.verdict:
ELISA MBALI can win again. Chariklo is a big danger, while The Mightiest also merits respect.

  1. ELISA MBALI (SAF)
  2. CHARIKLO (SAF)
  3. THE MIGHTIEST (SAF)

races.name: www.tab.co.za Fm 98 Divided Handicap (F & M)
races.verdict:
DOESYOURMOTHERKNOW makes plenty of appeal. Trip Of Faith may be the one for second, while Blizzard Snow commands respect as well.

  1. DOESYOURMOTHERKNOW (SAF)
  2. TRIP OF FAITH (SAF)
  3. BLIZZARD SNOW (SAF)

races.name: Next Turffontein Racemeeting Saturday 3 October Fm 81 Divided Handicap (F & M)
races.verdict:
NAVIGATRIX looks promising and can win again. Social Graces is tough to ignore, while Irish Wilma is another worth looking at.

  1. NAVIGATRIX (SAF)
  2. SOCIAL GRACES (SAF)
  3. IRISH WILMA (SAF)
